name: Publish tagged package

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - '*-v*.*.*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: 'Release tag in the form <package-slug>-v<version>'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: publish-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.release_tag || github.ref_name }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org

      - name: Resolve publish target
        id: resolve
        run: node ./scripts/resolve-release-tag.mjs "${RELEASE_TAG}"

      - name: Install package dependencies
        working-directory: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.pkg_path }}
        run: npm install --workspaces=false --package-lock=false

      - name: Build package
        working-directory: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.pkg_path }}
        run: npm run build

      - name: Test package
        working-directory: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.pkg_path }}
        run: npm test

      - name: Pack package
        working-directory: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.pkg_path }}
        run: npm pack --json

      - name: Publish package
        working-directory: ${{ steps.resolve.outputs.pkg_path }}
        run: npm publish --access public
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
